name: Snakeskin Veil — "It gains hexproof" takes only a creature you control
notes: Memory: project_pronoun_target_antecedent_restriction_2026-10-14. 'Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains hexproof until end of turn.' The 'It' effect became the spell's target with no restriction, so the picker offered every permanent (the opponent's creatures, lands). It now takes the restriction of its antecedent, 'target creature you control'.
